head: Gemini 4 Hydrogen: a faster Gemini 4 model for everyone in the Gemini app
dek: Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a faster model for everyday tasks and coding, and it's available to everyone in the Gemini app and Google Search, not just paying subscribers.
details: Google says Hydrogen scores slightly above Gemini 4 Argon on an independent intelligence index while often finishing tasks faster, and that it makes up claims more than five times less often than Gemini 3.8 Flash. Developers pay $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens. In Google's Antigravity coding tool, a new Orchestrator switches between Hydrogen and the larger Carbon model in one session.
where: Gemini app and Google Search, worldwide; Google AI Studio and the Gemini API
means: Free Gemini users get a newer Gemini 4 model without upgrading their plan.
todo: Open the Gemini app and pick Hydrogen in the model menu if it isn't chosen for you already.
